description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Supplies -------

description: Sailors' rum and water. Restores 30 Health, but leaves you Tipsy.
name: All-Seafarer Grog

description: Water from a sacred well. Restores 15 Mana.
name: Well Water

description: A pungent mint. Its smell cures Sleep and Hypnotized.
name: Pennyroyal Sprig

description: Chewed ephedra. Fatigue -20.
name: Ephedra Twigs

description: A strip of cloth, burrbark or paper. Stops Bleed.
name: Bandage
note: Made from cloth, burrbark or paper (crafting later).

description: Acid from the hot springs, for refreshing a Voltaic Pile. Restores 2 charge.
name: Acid Jar

description: A numbing ceremonial drink. Restores 40 Mana, but Fatigue +10.
name: Kava

description: Rain caught from the sacred rain tree. Restores 80 Mana.
name: Sacred Dew

description: Held smouldering under the nose: jolts someone back to their senses. Shakes off Weary and Stunned (Fatigue -15).
name: Burnt Feather

description: Pine-pitch or bone glue. Re-sets the head or edging of an equipped glued weapon (axes, hammers, clubs, maces, paddle-swords) back to new.
name: Glue

description: A bow drill and tinder. Lights a campfire; used up. Earth ovens don't need one.
name: Fire-Starting Kit

description: Re-lashes an equipped sinew-bound weapon (knives, spears, harpoons) back to new.
name: Sinew Binding

description: Fresh copper and lead discs for a Voltaic Pile: restores 3 charge.
name: Battery Discs

description: Seawater in a clay jar. Poured into a Voltaic Pile it restores 1 charge; Juda's chlorine starts with brine.
name: Brine Jar

description: Syrup berries boiled down. Restores 10 Mana and eases Fatigue (-15). Children love it.
name: Berry Syrup

description: Fermented palm sap. Restores 25 Mana and eases Fatigue (-10), but leaves you Tipsy.
name: Palm Wine

description: Rendered seabird oil in a little lamp: +10% hit in caves and animals fear it (Threaten +25%), for two battles.
name: Shearwater Oil

description: Wax-myrtle berry wax, rubbed on a bowstring: +1 arrow, and the bow keeps its power while Wet, this battle. Also a crafting material.
name: Myrtle Wax

description: A wax-myrtle candle. For lighting dark places (field use comes later).
name: Myrtle Candle
note: Field item: lights dark map areas once overworld work is done.

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Food & Drink -------

description: Barley bread. Heals 10; max Health +3 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Barley Bread

description: Sun-dried fish. Heals 10; Endurance +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Dried Fish

description: Fresh meat. Cook it at a fire, or trade it.
name: Raw Meat

description: A gourd of fresh water. Washes off salt (cures Salting) and restores 5 Health.
name: Fresh Water

description: Toasted barley flour, the Islanders' staple. Heals 20; max Health +5 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Toasted Barley

description: Meat roasted over coals. Heals 25; Might +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Grilled Meat

description: Hard, salty goat cheese. Heals 15; Might +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Goat Cheese

description: A pot of lentil stew for everyone. Heals 15; Endurance +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Lentil Stew

description: Sweet dried figs; children love them. Heals 10; Speed +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Dried Figs

description: A bunch of grapes from the volcanic vineyards. Heals 10; Speed +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Grapes

description: Limpets, winkles and mussels from the shore rocks. Heals 10; max Mana +3 for good. Eaten raw, a bad one may envenom you (10%). A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Shellfish

description: Fresh goat milk. Heals 10; max Mana +3 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Goat Milk

description: Palm-sap syrup. Heals 15 and 10 Mana; Spirit +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Palm Honey

description: Wine from the island's own grapes. 15 Mana; Spirit +1 for good; leaves you Tipsy. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Islander Wine

description: A sacred egg, laid beneath the idols of the Sooty Bird by a bird no one has ever seen. Full Health; Might, Endurance, Spirit, Speed +1 and max Health +5 for good. Once per person. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Sooty Bird Egg

description: Flour pounded from fern roots: famine food, but it fills you. Heals 5; max Health +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Fern-Root Flour

description: Sticky laurel-forest berries. Eases Fatigue (-5). Boil them into Berry Syrup.
name: Syrup Berries

description: Red, rough-skinned fruit from the dry slopes. Heals 10; Speed +1 for good. Overripe ones may leave you Tipsy. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Strawberry-Tree Fruit

description: The rare orange fruit of the bellflower. Full Health; max Mana +5 for good. Once per person. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Bellflower Fruit

description: An everyday hen's egg. Heals 10; Endurance +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Hen's Egg

description: A whole bird from the earth oven. Heals 20; Might +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Roast Chicken

description: Marsh eel, smoked over juniper. Heals 15; Speed +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Smoked Eel

description: Grilled octopus. Clever creatures, they say. Heals 15; Spirit +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Octopus

description: Sea turtle, a chief's dish. Full Health; max Health +5 and Endurance +1 for good. Once per person. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Turtle Stew

description: Eggs taken from the cliff colonies. Heals 10; max Health +3 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Seabird Eggs

description: A Seafarer ship's ration: beef packed in salt. Heals 25; Might +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Salt Beef

description: Milk from Seafarer cattle. Heals 15; max Health +3 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Cow's Milk

description: A round of hard cow's-milk cheese. Heals 20; Endurance +1 for good. A meal: eat it outside battle; one meal per rest.
name: Seafarer Cheese

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Herbal Remedies -------

description: Red resin from the dragon tree. Revives a fallen ally at 10% Health, sealed in a resin shell that blocks one attack.
name: Dragon's Blood

description: A hot, bitter wormwood tea. Breaks a fever and warms you: cures Feverish and Chilled.
name: Bitterwood Tea

description: Bitterwood burned as temple incense. Clears Despair and Panicked from the party, and Rite works 30% better for a while.
name: Bitterwood Smudge

description: A cliff-mint tea for colds. Eases Fatigue (-10) and cures Chilled and Wet (and Sodden).
name: Cliff Mint Tea

description: A thyme tea that settles the stomach. Cures Venom.
name: Hill Thyme Tea

description: "Mountain tea": a slow tonic. Mends 3% Health per turn for 6 turns (stacks with Mending) and eases Fatigue (-5).
name: Ironwort Tonic

description: A poultice for burns. Restores 20 Health and cures Smoldering and Enflamed.
name: Burnwort Poultice

description: A sedative draught. Cures Panicked and Enraged.
name: Burnwort Draught

description: Laurel oil rubbed into aching joints. Eases Fatigue (-20) and cures Burdened, Mired and Chilled.
name: Laurel Oil

description: A sour roadside herb. Restores 8 Health and mends slowly (2% per turn for 6 turns).
name: Moon Sorrel

description: Caustic spurge latex, thrown at the eyes. Burn damage and Dazzled. Handle with care.
name: Spurge Milk

description: Spurge latex smeared on a blade. For the battle, attacks may envenom (30%).
name: Spurge Coating

description: Ti leaves wrapped on burns and fevers. Mends 5% Health per turn for 3 turns and cures Feverish and Smoldering (and Enflamed).
name: Ti Leaf Wrap

description: The sweet root of the ti plant. Restores 10 Health and eases Fatigue (-5). Animals like it.
name: Ti Root

description: Yellowroot steeped for ear complaints. Restores balance: cures Disoriented and Confused (and Feverish).
name: Yellowroot Drops

description: Ritual yellow body paint. The wearer is Calm (the next mental ailment is warded off).
name: Yellowroot Paint

description: A bark remedy for skin and eyes. Cures Dazzled.
name: Milo Bark

description: A tunnel-fern poultice that keeps the skin from crusting. Salting can't take hold until the battle ends.
name: Wart Fern Poultice

description: White clay stirred into water: settles the stomach. Cures Tipsy.
name: White Clay Draught

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Materials -------

description: Bent, broken copper. Melts into a Copper Ingot.
name: Scrap Copper
note: Material: what a copper weapon leaves when it breaks.

description: Broken copper-silver. Melts into a Copper Ingot and a Silver Ingot.
name: Scrap Copper-Silver
note: Material: what a copper-silver weapon leaves when it breaks.

description: A raw animal hide. For leatherwork, or trade.
name: Hide

description: A curved tusk. Carvers want these.
name: Boar Tusk

description: A hard shell or claw casing.
name: Shell

description: A centipede venom sac. Priests and hunters have uses for it.
name: Venom Sac

description: A long amber-flecked feather. Unlucky, they say.
name: Owl Feather

description: Dried tendon, for lashings and bowstrings.
name: Sinew

description: Animal bone, for tools and carving.
name: Bone

description: Deer or ibex antler.
name: Antler

description: Coarse goat hair.
name: Goat Wool

description: Thick mountain wool.
name: Mouflon Wool

description: Oily, water-shedding skin.
name: Seal Skin

description: A plate of giant-tortoise shell.
name: Tortoise Scute

description: Volcanic glass, ready for knapping.
name: Obsidian Shard

description: Galena from the silver-lead mine. Melts into a Lead Ingot, and sometimes a Silver Ingot: the island's silver is all in its lead.
name: Lead Ore

description: Green-stained copper ore. Melts into a Copper Ingot.
name: Copper Ore

description: A row of shark teeth, for edging knives and paddle-swords.
name: Shark Tooth

description: A small, tough piece of chalcedony from the hot springs. Knap it into blades.
name: Chalcedony

description: Yellow crater sulfur.
name: Sulfur

description: Sticky resin, for glue, torches and waterproofing.
name: Pine Pitch

description: The red-dye lichen, the island's great export.
name: Orchil Lichen

description: Potter's clay.
name: Clay

description: A branch of coral.
name: Coral

description: A sea pearl. Thieves want it.
name: Pearl

description: A living bough from a Green Horse. Light and still green.
name: Green Horse Bough

description: A scale shed by a Guardian Lizard.
name: Guardian Lizard Scale

description: A demonic hound's pelt. It feels wrong.
name: Black Hound Pelt

description: A feather from a Hag of the Salt Marsh.
name: Hag-Crane Feather

description: A rib-thin carved ancestor figure from a First Sailor tomb. Traders pay well.
name: Skeletal Figurine
note: Treasure: sell it, or keep it for later.

description: A piece of a First Sailor glyph tablet. Scholars and priests want it.
name: Glyph Tablet Shard
note: Treasure: sell it, or keep it for later.

description: A bead of black bronze: copper, silver and gold. Thieves want it.
name: First Sailor Bead
note:
Treasure: sell it, or keep it for later.
<Shiny>

description: Green crystals from the lava fields, "volcano tears". Traders want them.
name: Olivine

description: Red earth pigment, for paint, pottery and grave goods.
name: Red Ochre

description: Salt from the shore pans, for preserving fish and meat.
name: Sea Salt

description: Light, porous red stone, sacred for statue topknots and eye pupils.
name: Red Scoria

description: Fine white clay: pigment, and medicine for the stomach.
name: White Clay

description: A log of fine reddish hardwood. It never splits. Carve it into paddle-swords and clubs.
name: Mahogany Log

description: Honey-palm fronds, for baskets, thatch and fans.
name: Palm Fronds

description: A rare, fragrant branch, nearly gone from the island. Carve it into a staff.
name: Sandalwood Branch

description: A dried bottle gourd: a canteen, a float or a rattle.
name: Gourd

description: A First Sailor burial box of sandalwood, still fragrant. Traders pay well.
name: Sandalwood Casket
note: Treasure: sell it, or keep it for later.

description: Red jasper, sacred to priests. Knap it into blades spirits respect.
name: Jasper

description: A heavy basalt block. Knap it into axe and hammer heads.
name: Basalt

description: Lighter andesite. Knap it into adze and hammer heads, or spear points.
name: Andesite

description: Tanned hide, from the tanner. Knife handles and leatherwork.
name: Leather

description: Ground bone, shell and tooth. Used in pottery, glue and paint.
name: Bonemeal

description: Broken pottery. Pottery can be made from potsherds instead of raw clay.
name: Potsherds

description: A cast copper ingot. Smiths make copper weapons from these.
name: Copper Ingot

description: A cast lead ingot.
name: Lead Ingot

description: A cast silver ingot. Electroplaters use these.
name: Silver Ingot

description: Thick hide from Seafarer cattle. Heavier than goat or boar.
name: Cowhide

description: Long, strong hair from a horse's tail: bowstrings, plumes, brushes.
name: Horsehair

description: A big horn from Seafarer oxen. Horn-bow material.
name: Ox Horn

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Battle Items -------

description: Caustic lye: acid Burn damage and Endurance down for 3 turns.
name: Lye Flask

description: Burning pine pitch in a clay pot: fire damage, sets the target Smoldering.
name: Pitch Firepot

description: A cracked jar of Voltaic chlorine: light damage to all enemies, may cause Venom.
name: Chlorine Jar

description: Ash and grit to the eyes: Dazzled.
name: Ash Bag

description: Spurge latex in the water: Stunned. Only works on sea creatures.
name: Spurge Fish-Stunner

description: Scattered stone shards: each enemy may start to Bleed (50%). What broken stone weapons leave behind.
name: Stone Caltrops

description: Lead sling bullets: +3 sling stones and +6 sling power this battle.
name: Lead Shot

description: A smoking pot to slip away in: the party escapes (not from every fight).
name: Smoke Pot

description: A pitch torch: +10% hit in caves, and animals fear it (Threaten +25%) this battle.
name: Torch

description: Tempting scraps: an animal's mood rises by 15.
name: Bait Pouch

description: Blessed salt: harms spirits and ghosts. Does nothing to living things.
name: Purifying Salt

description: Red lichen war paint: Might up for 5 turns.
name: Orchil War Paint

description: Red resin paint: Endurance up for 5 turns.
name: Dragon's-Blood Paint

description: A pinch of sharp cliff-mint snuff: Speed up for 5 turns.
name: Mint Snuff

description: Red ochre grave paint: the dead see you as kin. Resolve up for 5 turns.
name: Ochre Grave Paint

description: White clay mourning paint: spirits take you for mourners. Every spirit's mood +15.
name: Mourning Paint

description: A block of sea salt. Goats and other grazers can't resist it: mood +20.
name: Salt Lick

description: A live hen to offer up. Spirits accept it gladly: mood +30. It's gone either way.
name: Offering Hen

description: Red scoria heated in the earth oven and thrown: Fire damage, and the warmth cures Chilled on the whole party.
name: Heated Scoria

description: An octopus's ink sac, burst in the water: Dazzled on every sea creature. Also a tattoo ink (crafting).
name: Octopus Ink

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Key Items -------

description: Flesh of the Great Boar, kept by Sib's magic. Becomes the body's flesh.
name: Great Boar Flesh

description: A little blood from Yoon's family: the twins, Mada, and Pada. Becomes the body's blood.
name: Kin's Blood

description: Mountain snow sealed in an urn, kept magically frozen. Becomes the brain.
name: Snow Urn

description: A bracelet of pure silver, to hold the pearl.
name: Silver Bracelet

description: A pearl from the sea. Set into the bracelet, it anchors the soul.
name: Sea Pearl

description: A living bellflower, kept magically alive. Becomes the heart.
name: Bellflower

description: A framework of dragon-tree wood. Becomes the skeleton.
name: Dragon-Tree Framework

description: Notes in Juda's hand on First Sailor homunculus making. Why would the priest study this?
name: Juda's Notes

description: A Seafarer spy's notes on the Islanders, in a language only some can read.
name: Parl's Notebook

description: Thirty years of tribute to the All-Seafarers, and whose advice it followed.
name: Tribute Ledger

description: A relay keeper's log: who sent what, and when.
name: Telegraph Log

description: A dented copper ball, fished out of the marsh. It once topped a staff.
name: Copper Ball

description: A rain-tree staff, snapped and buried in the woods. The top is missing.
name: Broken Staff

description: A hand quern of trachyte: grind flour, pigments, bonemeal and herb powders.
name: Trachyte Quern

description: A light reed boat for the marsh and the crater lakes. (Field use comes later.)
name: Reed Boat

description: Antler punches and a hammerstone: knap stone blades and heads at a campfire. Sib carries one.
name: Knapping Kit

description: Feathers, glue pot and a straightening stone: arrows and bowstrings at a campfire. Pada's.
name: Fletching Kit

description: A backstrap loom: weave cloth and clothing. Sold by weavers.
name: Backstrap Loom

description: Bone needles and fibre thread: charms, clothing the loom doesn't cover, nets and floats.
name: Needle & Thread

description: A clay cooking pot: boil syrups, teas and dyes at a campfire. Sold by herbalists.
name: Cooking Pot

description: A clay crucible and ingot mold: melt ore and scrap into ingots yourself (the fire needs peat or coal). Sold by smiths.
name: Crucible & Mold

description: Category header (not used in game).
name: ------- Wood & Fuel -------

description: Splintered wood from broken gear or the shore's driftwood. Fuel (1).
name: Scrap Wood

description: Cut marsh peat. Slow-burning fuel (4); hot enough to melt metal.
name: Peat

description: Soft coal from the marshes and caves. The best fuel (5); hot enough to melt metal.
name: Brown Coal

description: A laurel branch: the common firewood.
name: Laurel Branch

description: A laurel log: the common firewood.
name: Laurel Log

description: A springy tree-heather branch. Carve it into a staff or a plain spear.
name: Heather Branch

description: A straight alpine-ash branch, the best spear shaft: light (Speed +2).
name: Ash Branch

description: A resin-soaked pine branch. Spear shafts that shrug off fire (10% less Fire damage).
name: Pine Branch

description: A resin-soaked pine log, for shields and building.
name: Pine Log

description: A tough juniper branch: hafts for axes and hammers, and small bows.
name: Juniper Branch

description: A branch of hard, dark ebony. Carve it into a club.
name: Ebony Branch

description: A log of hard, dark ebony. Carve it into a paddle-sword body.
name: Ebony Log

description: An alpine yew branch, the wood for longbows.
name: Yew Branch

description: A rare dragon-tree branch soaked in its own red resin. Carve and fire-harden it into a greatsword.
name: Dragonheart Branch

description: A fallen branch of the sacred rain tree. The tree is never cut; branches are found or given by priests.
name: Rain-Tree Branch

description: A wax-myrtle branch. It burns well (fuel 3).
name: Wax Myrtle Branch

description: A fibrous honey-palm log, for building. Poor firewood.
name: Palm Log
